messages.author: 1e82ea932416652e
messages.subject: Re: Text Menu in RConsole... DeducerText
parts:
James,

It helps if you give details on the steps you performed to reproduce the problem, and include the results of SessionInfo().

Assuming you’re actually in JGR when you open the “Packages & Data” menu, select “Package Installer.” The dialog that pops up will either show a list of repositories, or a list of packages. If it’s repositories, select one near you. In the list of packages, scroll through until you find “DeducerText.” Select it. Click on “Install.” You only have to do this once; once it’s installed, you don’t have to install it the next time you run JGR.

With Deducer and DeducerText installed, type the command

library(“Deducer”)

Once Deducer loads, there will be a new submenu in “Packages & Data” called “GUI Add-Ons.” Select “Text.” This will load the DeducerText library.

You should now be good to go.

Note that the above will not work if you are in R.app (or R.exe, depending on which platform you’re using) as downloaded from CRAN. The CRAN R GUI cannot be used for Deducer.

- Tom
